authority: P03 experiment design representation only. Not a deployed J1/J2/J3 source, production schema, governing acceptance, or scored input.

restrictions: A Git path, filename, age, or presence in the corpus cannot imply semantic identity or current governing authority.
Source authority and currentness must be source-cited; unknown status is explicit rather than inferred from directory location.
Git blob identity is source-byte provenance, not an accepted effect identifier.
Acceptance and effect references used in the probe must be grounded in actual accepted records or explicitly marked synthetic V03 analogues.
Exact governed subjects are NOT Research 217 topical subjects or B3 navigation concerns.
Illustrative family labels are not a new selected production enum.
Only relations supported by source evidence or explicitly labeled synthetic fixture facts may be supplied.
Derived reverse/closure edges must preserve their source edge and cannot acquire new authority.
The exact same bounded connector-readable representation and access methods must be supplied to all arms.
Deleted derived indexes can reduce discovery but must not alter governing validity or current state.

B2.admission_rule: May only add a source-owned discovery/about relation not already contained in the common J1/J2/lineage/coverage/receipt substrate. Such links are navigation references, not new governing acceptance or J2 realization.
B2.collapse_rule: If every purported extra link duplicates a common relation, classify the arm as non-distinct before scoring rather than fabricating a difference.

B3.admission_rule: Navigation concerns are independently maintained concepts, not accepted-effect exact subjects, natural owner roles, authority statuses or general purpose semantic identities.

B4.admission_rule: Adds only labeled non-authoritative retrieval candidates to one prospectively selected justified structured arm, with matched retrieval budgets and explicit source provenance.

fairness_invariants: Identical source revision, source-role/currentness ground truth, common relations and derived orientation for every arm.
No generated navigation value, search rank or editorial about-link may create J1 authority.
All comparative authoring, maintenance and tool budgets are counted; historical B1 authoring is reported rather than credited as free.
No selected corpus, gold answer, evaluator transcript, candidate implementation or navigation score is provided by this design-only contract.
open_validation_questions: How will an independently reviewed oracle map actual current source authority and historical supersession into shared records without treating the future V03 software as already deployed?
Which physical public projection can all evaluators read through equivalent connector contracts?
Can non-duplicate B2 and genuinely distinct B3 additions be instantiated for the representative corpus?
How are optional B4 equalized engineering and index behavior qualified before inclusion?
